//: Realtime Database rules, kept only in case an instance is created later. The project has no Realtime Database today: google-services.json carries no firebase_url and the candidate hosts answer 404. All app data lives in Firestore, including the daily health metrics at users/{uid}/healthMetrics/{yyyy-MM-dd} and the demo panel overrides at users/{uid}/mockHealth/{yyyy-MM-dd}; firestore.rules is what covers them.
